name: Cube CLI
description: Remote control for the CubeSandbox control plane: sandbox lifecycle, ports and files.
whenToUse: Create, list, inspect, pause, resume, snapshot or delete a CubeSandbox; run commands or code inside a sandbox; upload and download files; debug control-plane connectivity.

cube_health.description: Check control-plane health and CLI version in one call; returns { healthy, exitCode, health:{stdout,stderr,exitCode}, version:{...} }.

cube_new.description: Create a CubeSandbox with complete metadata. purpose (one short Chinese sentence -> metadata.note), agent (main/sub agent identity -> metadata.agent) and dialogue (conversation ID -> separate metadata.dialogue, also sent as the X-Caller header) are required. Template resolution + creation share a 110s budget (host call limit 120s); returns { sandboxId, templateId, gatewayUrl, aiodBase, metadata, warnings, stdout, stderr, exitCode }. If it times out the sandbox may still exist: find it with cube_ls metadata=dialogue=<ID>.

cube_ls.description: List sandboxes (ID / template / state / note); returns { stdout, stderr, exitCode }. Filter by metadata (e.g. dialogue=<ID>) to trace a conversation or clean up leftovers.

cube_rm.description: Destroy a sandbox and stop its processes; returns { stdout, stderr, exitCode }. Irreversible.

cube_exec.description: Run one shell command inside a sandbox as a single argv after `--` (no host shell, leading dashes survive); returns { stdout, stderr, exitCode }. Sync limit 100s; use cube_submit for longer tasks.

cube_code.description: Run a code snippet inside a sandbox through the interpreter, multi-line safe; returns { stdout, stderr, exitCode }. Sync limit 100s.

cube_write_file.description: Write a string to a file inside a sandbox byte-exactly (no escaping); returns { path, bytes, exitCode }.

cube_read_file.description: Read a sandbox file as text; returns { path, content, truncated, exitCode }. Default cap 256 KiB (max 1 MiB).

cube_run.description: Escape hatch for any other Cube CLI subcommand (info, ports, logs, pause, resume, snap, tpl-*, pty-*, raw...); returns { stdout, stderr, exitCode }. Sandbox creation and host-file upload are blocked here (use cube_new / cube_write_file). Bare --env=NAME is rejected.

/properties/cmd.description: Subcommand name, e.g. info, ports, logs, pause, resume, snap, tpl-ls, raw.

/properties/args.description: Argument array, one item per flag, e.g. ["sid"] or ["GET", "/health"].

cube_submit.description: Start a long-running control-plane task asynchronously and return { taskId, cmd, status, message }; read it with cube_log (which also returns sandboxId/templateId for cmd='new' once complete). Poll every 60-90s so the worker is not idle-reclaimed. For long in-sandbox commands use cube_run exec-async + exec-logs.

cube_log.description: Read logs of a cube_submit task (incremental by offset); returns { taskId, status, completed, exitCode, logs, nextOffset, totalLines }.

cube_kill.description: Terminate a task started by cube_submit; returns { taskId, killed }.
